brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage, checking that obstruction does not exceed one quarter of the free area and that insect mesh is intact (SOP-015). Prove full travel on any motorised or thermostatic dampers on a thermostat call, lubricating stiff linkages rather than merely noting them (SOP-015). Walk the airflow path to confirm no stored material or temporary screening obstructs it, clearing any obstruction in preference to deferring it (SOP-015).
